note: Length: mbCookieLength in TestMobikeCookie2ResponseControlsMigration fails on a generated cookie outside 8..64, TestMobikeCookie2EchoBounds rejects received 7- and 65-octet cookies. Unpredictable: TestRFC4555Cookie2IsTheRandomSourceOutput replaces crypto/rand.Reader per startMobikeRequest call with two differently seeded streams and asserts each real MOBIKE request's COOKIE2 equals the first 32 octets of its own stream, so a counter, timestamp, SA-derived value or fixed-seed PRNG goes red. The record is a whole-producer panic (reach); discrimination read from the equality assertion.
